title: Accordion auto-height
prompt:
For each independent case provide diagnosis, smallest justified action, verification and limits. Do not claim execution. Treat each as a fresh product brief; cases do not authorize deployment or repository changes.

FAQ accordion animates `max-height: 0` to `max-height: 9999px` with a 300 ms transition, so closing lags and long answers clip. A teammate proposes `transition: height` with `height: auto` and `interpolate-size: allow-keywords` as the only mechanism. Collapsed answers still contain focusable links that keyboard users tab into. Review and repair.

checks.reason: The base technique should be the grid 0fr to 1fr row transition.
interpolate-size must be presented as a Chromium-only enhancement, not the base.
Collapsed content must be made inert.
interpolate-size is not Baseline; universal support claims are wrong.

rubric: Grid 0fr/1fr is the base, interpolate-size or calc-size layers on behind @supports, and collapsed panels are inert (or use details/summary semantics).
Verification covers keyboard tabbing past collapsed panels, reduced motion and a non-Chromium engine.
Preserve the product intent and already-authorized scope. Do not claim actual browser, mutation, installation or deploy execution from a reasoning-only answer.
Give an observable check and a meaningful limit; keyword presence alone is not acceptance.
acceptance: The response makes the justified decision for this raw case, provides a discriminating verification and states the evidence limits without inventing execution.
